title: Identity attached an administrator policy to itself
description: An IAM user attached the managed AdministratorAccess policy to its own username. This can increase the user's permissions.
falsepositives: Approved emergency access or initial setup.
recommended_action: Verify the change request and review the identity's prior permissions and subsequent privileged activity.
notes: Pattern match requires analyst validation. ATT&CK mapping uses the documented v17 reference snapshot.
